name: Abrams
playstyle: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.
lore: Hard hitting, hard headed, and hard drinking; Detective Abrams has been a fixture on the New York investigating scene for years. From stolen art, to missing persons, to ritual murders; Abrams didn't just take any case that came across his desk... he solved them. But his days of following cheating spouses came to an end the day he opened his office door and found The Tome sitting on his desk. No instruction was left for him save for a brief note scrawled in onyx blood that read "Don't let them have it". Abrams hasn't figured where the thing came from; but seeing as his home has been broken into, his office tossed on 3 different occasions, and his car firebombed he has a vested interest in figuring out what the hell is going on.

beginner.whatItIs: Abrams is a close-range brawler. He fights with a close-range spreadshot gun, heals himself by draining enemies who stand next to him, drags enemies along with a shoulder charge, and finishes with a leap that stuns whoever he lands on.
beginner.whyItMatters: His spreadshot gun is a close-range weapon, and one of his two ways to heal, Siphon Life, only drains enemies who are near him. His other one, Infernal Resilience, is always on and gives back part of the damage he takes, so he does his work up close and can recover even when no enemy is standing next to him.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to fight up close and stay healthy while doing it. Drain enemies with Siphon Life when they are around you, and rely on Infernal Resilience when they are not. His ultimate stuns where it lands, so save it for a group standing together rather than one runner.
beginner.firstHeroReason: His complexity rating in the game data is 1, the lowest any hero has, and the plan is simple: walk up to enemies and shoot.

abilities.abrams-siphon-life: Use it when enemies are standing around you. It hurts them over a few seconds and heals you for part of the damage it deals.
abilities.abrams-shoulder-charge: Your way in. You charge forward and take the enemies you hit along with you, and pushing a hero into a wall stuns them.
abilities.abrams-infernal-resilience: Always on. When you take damage, part of it (13 percent in the game data) comes back to you as health spread over 20 seconds.
abilities.abrams-seismic-impact: Your ultimate, the big ability with a 215 second cooldown. You jump up and land hard, hurting and stunning what is under you.

name: Apollo
lore: A land of beauty, tradition and conflict; North Ixia is no stranger to brutal political violence. So when Apollo was told that it was for his own safety he was being sent to New York for school, he knew the situation was serious. Adjusting to life at Blackmore Academy didn't come easy to Apollo. His school was supposed to be filled with The Cursed Apple's best and brightest but all he saw, with few exceptions, was a sea of aggressive mediocrity. Electing not to waste his time with frivolous things like parties and dances, he instead put his energy on the piste, where he rigorously trains as captain of the Blackmore fencing team. However, at the end of the day Apollo does not fret too much on the tedium of life in New York. He knows that eventually the time will come when his father will call on him to come home and he will get to show that he is worthy of wielding his family's ancestral blade.

beginner.whatItIs: Apollo is a sword assassin. He leaps backward from a sigil that slows enemies, deflects the next incoming attack and then dashes at an enemy hero to stun them, makes up to three lunges in any direction with a stab that hits ahead of him, and ends with a long-range slash that freezes enemies in slow motion before it hurts them.
beginner.whyItMatters: His kit rewards timing. The deflect only works if you read the enemy's attack, and the ultimate does its damage after a delay, so the hit lands when the freeze ends rather than when you press the button.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like fighting with a sword and picking the exact moment to strike. Use the backward leap to get out of trouble, and save the ultimate for a target you can afford to wait on.

abilities.apollo-disengaging-sigil: Draw the sigil in front of you and leap backwards as it detonates, dealing damage and slowing any enemy caught in the blast. Use it to disengage when an enemy closes in on you.
abilities.apollo-riposte: Activate this before an attack lands to deflect it, then pick an enemy hero to dash into and stun. It is your answer when an enemy is about to hit you.
abilities.apollo-flawless-advance: Hold the key to build up your lunge, then release during the perfect window for maximum damage. Each lunge drives piercing stabs forward in whatever direction you face.
abilities.apollo-itani-lo-sahn: Your ultimate. Hold to charge a long range slash, then release it to trap enemies in slow motion where they cannot act or recover, and you stay invulnerable until the damage burst hits.

name: Baba
lore: There are a few things most denizens of The Cursed Apple hope to experience at some point in their lives. See a Broadway show. Ice Skate at Rockefeller Center during Christmas season. Get yelled at by the Central Park Pigeon Lady. Because Baba is more than just an old woman that feeds spirit pigeons in the park... she's an institution. A force of nature woven into the very lore of New York City. Is it true that she's sat at the same bench every day for the past 50 years, rain or shine? Maybe. Is she REALLY the leader of The Soho Coven? Who's to say. One thing's for sure though... she's a New Yorker. And she's not going to sit back and watch a bunch of tourists tear apart Manhattan in pursuit of power.

beginner.whatItIs: Baba is a hexing witch who brawls on the front line from her walking bench. She steals Spirit from enemies with a thread, which also makes her bullets deal bonus spirit damage, stretches her bench's legs to run, jump and kick, throws a tea pot that cycles between a barrier, a silence and a burn, and ends by turning enemies into pigeons.
beginner.whyItMatters: She has a mix of tools: a way to steal power, a way to move fast, an area effect and a big finisher. The tea pot changes what it does over time, so where and when you throw it decides whether it helps or hurts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want a spell-heavy hero who fights in the thick of it rather than hanging back. Land the thread first so your bullets hit harder, throw the tea where the fight is going to be, and keep the ultimate for when several enemies are standing in front of you.

abilities.baba-threadsap: Weave a thread that follows your crosshair, then bursts along its path to deal spirit damage and steal enemy Spirit. Holding stolen Spirit makes every bullet you fire deal bonus spirit damage.
abilities.baba-granny-long-legs: Your bench's legs extend, giving you extra move speed, higher jumps, and resistances. Use your light melee to kick enemies back, your heavy melee to ground pound them into a knockup and slow, and hold crouch to charge a high jump.
abilities.baba-babas-brew: Throw a brewed pot of tea into an area to apply its rotating effect of barrier, Silence, or burn. Press Alt Fire to pause the brew so you can pick which effect lands.
abilities.baba-feed-the-birds: Your ultimate. Toss bread ahead of you to slow enemies and build up stacks, and when the channel ends a pigeon swarm hurts them and turns each into a pigeon, hitting harder and lasting longer the more bread you land.

name: Bebop
role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo
playstyle: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.
lore: Forged by the hands of a widowed junk yard attendant; Bebop was more than just some scrap golem laborer... he was the son she couldn't have. Together they would work in the iron yard during the day, and listen to jazz at night. It was a predictable, if not comforting routine. But now, Bebop's creator has fallen ill and while Miss Shelly wouldn't approve of the activities that Bebop does at night to pay for her medicine, what she doesn't know can't hurt her.

beginner.whatItIs: Bebop is a big brawler with a beam weapon. He punches enemies up with an uppercut, sticks a bomb on a target, pulls a character toward him with a mechanical hand, and channels a long beam as his ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The grapple hand and the uppercut let him control who is where. Hitting a hero with the sticky bomb makes that bomb stronger for later, so landing it on heroes is better than wasting it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to grab an enemy and keep them in your face. The grapple and the uppercut also work on allies, so you can use them to move a teammate out of danger.

abilities.bebop-exploding-uppercut: Knock nearby enemies away, and when they land they hurt other enemies around them and make them shoot slower. You can also use it on an ally to shove them clear of danger.
abilities.bebop-sticky-bomb: Stick a bomb on an enemy and it pops after a moment, hurting enemies close by. Landing it on a hero or getting a kill with it makes the bomb hit harder permanently.
abilities.bebop-grapple-arm: Fire a mechanical hand at a target to yank them right next to you. It works on allies too, so you can pull a teammate to safety or grab an enemy to set up your combo.
abilities.bebop-hyper-beam: Your ultimate. You channel a powerful beam that damages and slows any enemy it hits, and it keeps going for a long time, so line up a group of enemies to get the most out of it.

name: Billy
lore: Billy is a white hot ball of rage, furious at the very notion of...something. Maybe it's the cops. Maybe it's magic regulations. Maybe it's the service at the gyro place downtown. (Not the good one. The other one.) Don't ask him how he got the goat head.

beginner.whatItIs: Billy is a close-range brawler with a bat and a short-range gun. He slams enemies down with the bat, rams into a target and carries it into the air, restores ammo with melee hits, and chains nearby enemies to himself before yanking them in.
beginner.whyItMatters: Everything about him is up close. Melee hits give him ammo back and mark the victim, so he gets stronger by staying in melee range instead of backing away.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to run straight at people. Use the ram to start the fight, and the chain ultimate when several enemies are close to you and you want to drag them all back in.

abilities.billy-bashdown: Smash the ground in front of you to send nearby enemies flying and knock them up. Use it when enemies are bunched around you.
abilities.billy-rising-ram: Dive straight at an enemy and launch both of you into the air together. Landing the hit cuts the cooldown short, so you can use it again sooner.
abilities.billy-blasted: Always on. Every melee hit you land restores your ammo and marks the victim as wrecked for a few seconds.
abilities.billy-chain-gang: Your ultimate. Tether nearby enemies so they cannot use movement abilities, then after a short delay yank everyone in close for spirit damage, but the chains break if you lose sight of them.

name: Calico
playstyle: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.
lore: Once a decorated member of The Baxter Society, Calico left the august order once she realized that killing monsters for free was less profitable than killing people for money. Now an in demand contract killer, Calico is living her best life ending someone else's.

beginner.whatItIs: Calico is a quick shadow assassin with a spreadshot gun. She throws bombs that go off after a short delay, dashes in with a slash that hits everyone around her and heals her if it catches a hero, possesses her cat Ava to move fast and stay hidden on the minimap, and for her ultimate turns to shadow: she becomes untargetable (not invisible), gains move speed and deals spirit damage, then returns from the shadows with a second blast.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her bombs explode on a delay, and a target caught by more than one bomb takes reduced damage from them (65 percent in the game data). Even so, several bombs on one hero add up to more than a single bomb, so aim at the middle of the target. The ultimate makes her untargetable, not invisible, until she returns from the shadows.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like hit-and-run play. Slash in, use the shadow form to leave, and use the ultimate to dodge when a fight turns against you or to open a fight with damage.

abilities.calico-gloom-bombs: Lob a cluster of bombs that pop after a short delay for spirit damage, so aim them where foes are grouped up.
abilities.calico-leaping-slash: Dash forward and hit every enemy around you in a circle for melee damage. If you land it on a hero you also heal a little, making it a good way to close the gap and chip back some health.
abilities.calico-ava: Turn into shadow form and gain growing move speed while staying hidden from the minimap. If an enemy hero hits you, you lose the speed bonus and must wait before using Ava again.
abilities.calico-return-to-shadows: Your ultimate. You melt into shadow where you cannot be targeted and you move faster, hurting nearby enemies with spirit damage, then snap back out after a moment to hit them once more - great for slipping out of trouble.

name: Celeste
lore: Even in a world of magic, some things are still rare and unusual. So what is a unicorn to do? Announce her presence to the world and potentially have poachers looking to saw off her horn? Or hide in plain sight at a Coney Island Side Show where most folk would assume her appearance was just part of an act? Over the years "The Dazzling Celeste" has grown into one of the more popular attractions on Coney, and while the applause from a cheering audience is appreciated; what keeps her waking up in the morning is the found family she's made at work. Keruba the Mermaid. Blockhead Lenny. Chickenwing. Ted. These were her people. So when she discovered that one of her own sold part of their soul in order to cover a gambling debt, Celeste knew it was time to step out of the shadows and do whatever it takes to get it back. Is revealing her power to The Patrons a risk? Yes. But that's tomorrow's problem... her family needs help today.

beginner.whatItIs: Celeste is a light caster whose gun fires one arcing, bouncy shot at a time. She blasts a cone of light that makes enemies take extra damage from her, wraps herself in a prism barrier, calls down a beam from the sky, and launches a bouncing orb of light as her ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her first ability sets up the rest: enemies she has blasted take extra spirit damage when she attacks them, and it gives her lifesteal. If her barrier is destroyed, it silences and damages the enemies near her, not just whoever broke it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want a caster that mixes shooting and spells. Open with the light blast, then follow with the beam and your gun. Cast the barrier once the fight has started, because it only lasts 4 seconds; if enemies break it, the ones near her are silenced.

abilities.celeste-light-eater: Blast enemies ahead of you to mark them, then attack them with your weapon so the hits hurt them more and heal you over a short while.
abilities.celeste-dazzling-trick: Wrap yourself in a barrier and let them break it, because when they do you silence the enemies around you and deal them a chunk of damage.
abilities.celeste-radiant-daggers: Call a beam down onto a spot and wait a moment for it to explode and hit everyone standing there. Each time it lands on an enemy hero you build up extra spirit damage.
abilities.celeste-shining-wonder: Your ultimate. Hold it and release to send a bright orb that hits an enemy, slows them, shrinks how far they can dash, and bounces on to other enemies close by.

name: Deadman Danny
lore: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I'm going to tell you a shocking secret: at Fairfax Industries we know nothing about safety. Now let me tell you something even MORE shocking... that's a good thing! Now in my tenure here I have been shot, stabbed, impaled, defenestrated, blown up, atomized, and decapitated-not once. not twice. not thrice. but quice. That's right, my head has been cut off enough times that I had to use a made up word to quantify it. But I put myself through figurative and sometimes literal hell because it's not enough to THINK about how things go wrong, we need to KNOW how things go wrong. Now the demonstration you are about to witness is extremely dangerous. So sit back. Put on your safety googles. And bear witness to the miracle of flight courtesy of Fairfax Industries, and the Chimera Mark 1." - This transcription of Danny's opening remarks at The Military Technology Expo has been provided by Fairfax Industries

beginner.whatItIs: Deadman Danny is a jetpack marksman with a burst-fire gun. He fires a line of spirit missiles into the ground, flies with a jetpack that can overheat and dive-bomb, sprays fuel that ends in a blast pushing him backward, and grabs an enemy and slams them to the ground as his ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The jetpack is how he gets position, but it builds heat. If it overheats he dives to the ground and makes an explosion, so flying is a decision with a cost, not a free movement tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like using the air to pick fights on your terms. Fly to get to a good spot, and save the grab for a single enemy you want to remove from the fight.

abilities.deadman-danny-strix-salvo: Fire a line of missiles that plant in the ground and burst when enemies get near, marking them so your charged shots deal extra damage and slow them. Use it to zone a path before you walk into a fight.
abilities.deadman-danny-chimera-mk1: Hold Jump to fly, and the longer you stay up the more the engine heats until it forces a crash that hurls you and caught enemies upward. Tap the ability to drop early, but a clean miss leaves you dazed.
abilities.deadman-danny-jettison-fuel: Spray fuel at an enemy to shred their bullet resist and deal damage over time, and it vents your jetpack heat while it hits. The spray ends with a backblast that knocks you backwards, so fire it when you need to create some space.
abilities.deadman-danny-close-the-deal: Your ultimate. Grab a nearby enemy and fly high with them, then crash to the ground so both of you take spirit damage, and the hit is harder if they are already low on health.

name: Drifter
lore: An ancient vampire roaming across America, the nameless monstrosity known as The Drifter has been preying on the living for generations. Unlike most vampires, Drifter doesn't value finery or titles and has naked contempt for vampiric laws and tradition. This refusal to toe the line has made him a marked man all over the North American Baronies; but while Viscounts and Elders cry for his execution, Drifter continues to do what he pleases...

beginner.whatItIs: Drifter is a hunter assassin with a spreadshot gun. He claws at enemies in front of him, marks a target so he can reappear behind them, and covers nearby enemies in darkness with his ultimate so they cannot see well.
beginner.whyItMatters: His mark gives him a bleed and a way to jump behind a target. The ultimate shrinks how far the enemies it hits can see other units and counts them as isolated, so he is best when he gets one target alone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to hunt one enemy at a time. Mark a target, reappear behind them with the second press, and use the ultimate when you want your targets cut off from seeing their own team.

abilities.drifter-rend: Swing at whatever is in front of you in a wide arc, dealing spirit damage and a bonus melee hit if the target is in close range. Press it once you are already near the enemy.
abilities.drifter-stalkers-mark: Fire it at an enemy to make them bleed spirit damage over a few seconds. Once they are bleeding, you can press it again to teleport behind them for a reposition.
abilities.drifter-bloodscent: Always on. Isolated enemies leave a trail and beat a loud heartbeat you can hear from far away, you deal more damage to them, and when one dies nearby your weapon damage grows permanently.
abilities.drifter-eternal-night: Your ultimate. Shroud nearby enemy heroes in darkness so they can barely see anything, while you get a brief reveal on them, they count as isolated for the whole duration, and you move faster while sprinting.

name: Dynamo
playstyle: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.
lore: As a Scientist, Professor Dynamo always had an inquisitive mind. So when a rift in space and time opened up in central park he was first on the scene to investigate - and while he expected such a majestic sight to be life changing, he was thinking more in a metaphorical way as opposed to having his body atomized and reduced to a tiny dying star. But while his body is gone, his spirit and lust for knowledge lives on. A tenured professor at Columbia College, Dynamo looks to learn more about his condition while maintaining his class load, after all: he has future minds to inspire.

beginner.whatItIs: Dynamo is a support caster with a hard-hitting gun. He sends a pulse along the ground that knocks enemies up, teleports himself and nearby allies if he uses the alternate cast, channels a healing aurora, and creates a singularity that pulls enemies in and stuns them.
beginner.whyItMatters: He has both a rescue tool and a team-fight tool. The aurora heals him and nearby allies while he channels, and he can still dash and melee during it. The singularity bunches enemies up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to keep your team alive and set up team fights. Use the teleport to bring allies out of a bad spot, and save the singularity for a group of enemies standing together.

abilities.dynamo-kinetic-pulse: Fire it toward nearby enemies to knock them into the air and deal spirit damage. The pulse travels along the ground, so aim it in their direction.
abilities.dynamo-quantum-entanglement: Blink to a spot nearby to go untargetable for a moment and restore stamina. Use the alt cast to bring allies with you.
abilities.dynamo-rejuvenating-aurora: Channel it to heal yourself and nearby allies over a few seconds. You can keep dashing and meleeing while it runs, so hold it while repositioning.
abilities.dynamo-singularity: Your ultimate. It pulls nearby enemies toward you and stuns them while dealing spirit damage over time, so cast it when they are grouped together.

name: Graves
lore: The daughter of high-power defense attorneys, Darcy Graves grew up in a home where every conversation was a debate, argument, or negotiation. It was exhausting. But while her parents were often too busy meeting with clients or working on cases to bond with her, the dead were always there to listen. Graves enjoyed her time in the cemetery. It was a quiet place to calm her thoughts and talk through her problems...but one day her one-sided conversations started to change. It began with a faint whisper. A woman's voice that seemed to respond to Graves' complaints. Intrigued, the teenager listened...and followed the voice's instructions until it guided her to a lead-lined box buried in Van Cortlandt Park. But while most high school students would freak out if they were to unearth a severed lich hand, Graves was certainly not most teens. The hand now free of its prison, the lich's voice grew stronger... It had spent years looking to find a student she could pass her knowledge to, and Graves was eager to learn. Now a fledgling necromancer, Darcy balances not only her homework at Blackmore Academy...but the demands of graveyard denizens, each of whom have their own unfinished business that they seek her aid in resolving.

beginner.whatItIs: Graves is a spirit caster with a close-range beam weapon and a ghostly crew. She collects death whenever something dies nearby, throws a jar that summons Deadheads, raises a line of grasping hands that makes a Ghoul, damages enemies and holds in place any enemy who passes through, and steals weapon damage and resistance to spirit damage from her target.
beginner.whyItMatters: She gets power from what dies around her, so fighting where troopers and heroes are dying helps her. The line of hands both blocks space and damages enemies who cross it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like summoning helpers to fight for you. Use the hands to block a lane or a doorway, and throw the jar into an area where your target will stay.

abilities.graves-jar-of-dead: Always on. When things die nearby, their deaths feed your jar, and throwing the jar sends out Deadheads that chase enemies and deal spirit damage to them.
abilities.graves-grasping-hands: Unearth a line of hands on the ground to block a path, and enemies who walk through it take spirit damage and get immobilized. You can rotate its facing to point it a different way.
abilities.graves-essence-theft: Always on. As you hit an enemy with your weapon, you slowly steal some of their weapon damage and spirit resist, making them weaker the longer you keep hitting them.
abilities.graves-borrowed-decree: Your ultimate. Drop a gravestone on the ground that keeps summoning Ghouls to shamble toward the enemy base and explode near heroes, and protect it because enemies can break it down with heavy melee hits.

name: Grey Talon
playstyle: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.
lore: A founding member of "The Baxter Society", Wesley Grey Talon spent close to 40 years hunting monsters that preyed on man before finally deciding to find a replacement and lay down his bow. Grey Talon's duties had meant that he never spent much time with his wife and kid, and now that his son had started a family of his own he realized that this was his last chance to reconnect with the people he loved. Retirement suited Wesley. He made up for lost time with his wife. He doted on his grandkids. He cooked dinner for the whole family every Wednesday. He was happy. Then he got the call. The authorities claimed that it was a freak accident... that the fire consumed his son's house before anyone got a chance to escape. But Wesley knew better. His son's wife was an Ixian who could snuff out flame with a thought. If their bodies were found burned they had to be dead long before there was a fire. And so Grey Talon has picked up his bow once more, and when he finds who's responsible there will be a bloody reckoning.

beginner.whatItIs: Grey Talon is an archer. He charges a piercing arrow, launches himself high into the air to glide and shoot, sets a trap that curses a target and slows them, and steers a spirit owl into enemies to stun them.
beginner.whyItMatters: His kit mixes weapon and spirit damage. Rain of Arrows lifts him into the air, where his gun fires 5 arrows per shot with bonus weapon damage; Guided Owl is a 230 spirit damage blast that stuns, and Spirit Snare curses whoever walks into it. The charged arrow pierces through enemies, and the trap and the owl both give him a safe way to stop a target before it reaches him.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to stay back and hit hard with well-aimed shots. Place the trap where enemies will have to walk, and use the owl for a target you cannot reach any other way.

abilities.grey-talon-charged-shot: Hold it to charge a powerful shot that passes through enemies in its path. Aim it at a moving enemy and release once it is fully charged.
abilities.grey-talon-rain-of-arrows: Your way to reposition or escape. You jump high and glide slowly while your weapon shoots extra arrows, and you can land early with Jump or mantle.
abilities.grey-talon-spirit-snare: Place a trap in front of an enemy path and it will trigger when they walk into it, locking them down and silencing them. You can detonate it early by hitting it with a Charged Shot.
abilities.grey-talon-guided-owl: Your ultimate. Send out a spirit owl that you steer, hold W to speed it up, and it explodes on impact to damage and stun enemies.

name: Haze
playstyle: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.
lore: The Occult Security and Investigation Commission is a black box government organization that makes the CIA look transparent. It falls on the men, women, and entities of the OSIC to keep the country safe from sinister forces that are beyond the capabilities of local law enforcement. As a member of the notorious Sandman Division, Haze is routinely tasked with infiltrating the dreams of persons of interest, to assess their threat level, and if needed... to put them to sleep.

beginner.whatItIs: Haze is a sneaky assassin with a rapid-fire gun. She can turn invisible, put a target to sleep with a thrown dagger, and in her ultimate her gun fires on its own at enemies in a cone in front of her, up to 16 metres away, hitting one target with each shot.
beginner.whyItMatters: Attacking ends her invisibility but using items does not, and enemies who are close can still see her. So she picks her moment: appear, shoot, then finish the kill or leave.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want to start fights on your terms and end them quickly. Throwing the dagger does not break invisibility, so you can open with it from hiding. A sleeping target wakes up shortly after it is damaged, so only shoot it when you are ready to finish the job.
beginner.firstHeroReason: Complexity 1 in the game data, which no hero goes below; sneaking up and shooting is the whole plan.

abilities.haze-sleep-dagger: Throw it at one enemy to put them to sleep. Damage wakes them up after a moment, and throwing it does not make you visible.
abilities.haze-smoke-bomb: Fade out of sight. Attacking brings you back into view, using items does not, and nearby enemies can still see you. Its first upgrade grants +7 m/s sprint speed while you are invisible.
abilities.haze-fixation: Always on. Each bullet you land on the same target adds to your damage against them, and a headshot adds more than a body shot.
abilities.haze-bullet-dance: Your ultimate, with a 165 second cooldown. For a few seconds you automatically shoot enemies in a cone in front of you.

name: Holliday
playstyle: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.
lore: There are people who spent their whole lives dreaming about moving to New York. Holliday isn't one of those people. Content with being a Sheriff in a small town, Holliday enjoyed a career where the only time she had to use her gun was when trick shooting at the county fair...then the murders started. Grisly and inhumane; the bodies were found with their ribcages ripped open... their innards picked apart as if by birds. Holliday tracked down the killer, a travelling folk musician that the media dubbed "The Troubadour", but when she confronted him he exploded into a murder of crows and flew away. That was 6 months ago, and while the murders in central Illinois have stopped, Holliday's investigation has not. She believes that The Troubadour is travelling to New York, and when she finds him she's going to kill that evil son of a bitch.

beginner.whatItIs: Holliday is a gunslinger. She throws a barrel that explodes and sets enemies on fire, drops a bounce pad that launches any hero, gets bonus damage on headshots, and ends with a lasso that pulls and stuns a target.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her headshot bonus, Crackshot, is one extra hit of 55 damage on a 20 second cooldown, so aim for the head when it is ready. The bounce pad helps her move around, and using a bounce pad while her lasso is active adds 1.25 seconds to the lasso.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you enjoy aiming for the head and using terrain to move. Shoot the barrel to blow it up early when you want it to go off right away.

abilities.holliday-powder-keg: Throw a barrel ahead of you that explodes after a moment, knocking enemies up and setting them on fire. You can shoot it yourself to detonate it early, and overlapping barrels make the burn worse.
abilities.holliday-bounce-pad: Drop a pad on the ground and step on it to launch yourself into the air, then explode on landing to hurt nearby enemies. You can only trigger the landing blast once per pad, so pick your landing spot carefully.
abilities.holliday-crackshot: Your headshots hit harder than body shots and slow the target for a few seconds. You only get this bonus when the ability is off cooldown, so watch its state before aiming for the head.
abilities.holliday-spirit-lasso: Your ultimate. Throw the lasso at an enemy to pull them toward you and stun them, and using a Bounce Pad first makes the stun last longer.

name: Infernus
role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn
playstyle: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.
lore: Like most teenagers; Infernus was wild, rebellious, and impetuous. Unlike most teenagers, Infernus was a creature from another plane and had a supernatural mastery over fire. Needless to say: his youth was filled with no small amount of arson, murder, and evidence disposal. But that was then. Now an adult, Infernus has mellowed out considerably. He's happy working at a bar with good live music, and talking to interesting people. That being said when someone at the bar gets belligerent or violent, he's not afraid to dust off the skills he once honed.

beginner.whatItIs: Infernus is a fire marksman with a rapid-fire gun. He sprays burning fuel that slows enemies, dashes forward leaving a flaming trail, burns anyone he hits with his gun, and turns into a living bomb that stuns everyone nearby as his ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: His bullets build up a burn, and his abilities refresh that burn to its base length. Mixing gun and abilities keeps the fire on a target. The bomb cannot be interrupted once started.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want a damage-over-time shooter. Keep shooting a target to keep them burning, and save the bomb for a moment when the enemies are close together and you are ready to commit.

abilities.infernus-napalm: Spew napalm at an enemy to slow them and coat them in it. While they are coated, your damage against them is higher.
abilities.infernus-flame-dash: Dash forward to escape or chase. You are harder to slow while dashing, the trail you leave hurts enemies who cross it, and holding W carries you farther.
abilities.infernus-afterburn: Always on. Your weapon hits set enemies ablaze for spirit damage over time, and using an ability refreshes the burn while extra hits keep it burning longer.
abilities.infernus-concussive-combustion: Your ultimate. After a short delay you deal spirit damage and stun every nearby enemy, and once cast you cannot be interrupted so pick your moment carefully.

name: Ivy
role: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally
playstyle: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.
lore: The gargoyle didn't know what was happening when it sprang to life... just that a big human and a small human were being hurt. And so the gargoyle leapt to action, sending the attackers fleeing in horror. The small human said thank you and asked the gargoyle's name. The gargoyle didn't have one. And so the small human said, "I'm going to call you Ivy." The gargoyle, being covered in ivy at the time, thought it was a bit obvious, but decided to go along with it for the small human's sake. The humans asked if Ivy would come home with them so they could show their appreciation, and so Ivy walked with them. That night she learned much. The family were called The Arroyo's. The little one, Sophia. Mofongo is what they called a plate of deliciousness. But most importantly, she learned that the people attacking them were called "The Mendoza Syndicate", and they were hurting people...nice people like The Arroyo's. 18 years have passed since the day the Arroyo's took Ivy home... and during that time she made it her mission to dismantle the Mendoza Syndicate and free Spanish Harlem from its grasp. However the thing about dedicating your life to a single pursuit for nearly 2 decades is that you don't really know what to do once you achieve it. For the first time in her life, Ivy is prepared to venture outside of Spanish Harlem and see what the world has to offer beyond vigilante justice.

beginner.whatItIs: Ivy is a plant-themed marksman with a rapid-fire gun and a lot of help for her team. She summons slowing thorns, links with an ally for shared bonuses, turns to stone to smash and heal, and grabs an ally and flies with them to drop them on enemies.
beginner.whyItMatters: She is strongest when she has an ally to link with: the link copies part of the healing between them (35 percent in the game data) and lets her ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. Without a link she gets only half of the bonuses.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you play with friends or like supporting a teammate while shooting. Stay in line of sight of your linked ally, and use the stone form when you need to get out of damage and hit the enemies around you.

abilities.ivy-entangling-thorns: Fire a patch of choking thorns at a spot on the ground. It damages and slows any enemy standing in it, so use it to slow a chase or hold a lane.
abilities.ivy-kudzu-connection: Link with a nearby ally you can see to gain bonuses, share healing, and ignore the slow you get while shooting. Keep the link to your partner for the full effect.
abilities.ivy-stone-form: You become rock-solid and crash down, knocking nearby enemies into a brief stun while restoring some of your health. Use it when you have taken a lot of damage and want to rejoin the fight.
abilities.ivy-air-drop: Your ultimate. Lift a friendly hero into the air, then drop them onto enemies to detonate for spirit damage, and you both hit harder once the flight ends.

name: Kelvin
playstyle: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.
lore: A famed adventuring scientist, Kelvin made it his life's mission to explore and understand the unknowable. So naturally when rumors surfaced regarding an 8th astral gate hidden in the arctic, Kelvin couldn't build an expedition team fast enough. Assembling the brightest minds of his generation, Kelvin and his team set forth with much fanfare. They never returned. A year and a half later the frozen body of Kelvin was found by a fishing trawler, his corpse clutching a rock etched with glowing runes. The crew chipped away at the ice, looking to get a closer look at the body and were shocked when Kelvin opened his eyes. They checked his vitals... there was no pulse. They sought to bandage his open wounds... there was no blood. And yet, impossibly, Kelvin was "alive". Having no memory of what happened on the expedition, Kelvin is looking for answers.

beginner.whatItIs: Kelvin is an ice brawler with a heavy weapon. He throws grenades that heal allies and slow enemies, makes a path of ice that speeds up him and his allies, shoots a freezing beam, and puts a protective dome around himself or an ally.
beginner.whyItMatters: He is a team player: the grenade and the dome help allies, and his ice path gives movement to a whole group. The beam slows an enemy more the longer it stays on them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to protect friends and slow down enemies. Use the dome on whoever is in trouble, and keep the beam on a single target for as long as you can.

abilities.kelvin-frost-grenade: Throw it into a group of enemies to slow them and deal damage, while any allies caught in the freeze take healing. You carry multiple charges, so spend them when the fight matters.
abilities.kelvin-ice-path: Lay down a floating trail that gives you and your allies extra speed, and you also gain slow resistance. Use dash or crouch to travel up and down the path, and watch out because enemies can walk on it too.
abilities.kelvin-arctic-beam: Fire the beam at an enemy and hold it to make them move and shoot slower the longer you keep it on them. Be careful, you move slower while channeling, so find a safe angle first.
abilities.kelvin-frozen-shelter: Your ultimate. Place an impenetrable dome on yourself or a teammate to shield them from damage while they heal rapidly, and enemies inside are slowed.

name: Lady Geist
role: Sacrifices health then drains it back
playstyle: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.
lore: Once, Lady Jeanne Geist was the toast of the town. But as time passed and her beauty faded she found herself further and further from her glory days in High Society until finally she was nothing more than a frail woman in a nursing home, telling stories of a glorious past. And that's when Oathkeeper revealed himself. A powerful spirit from another plane, Oathkeeper offered her a path to reclaim her past glories... he could restore her youth; all she had to do was drain the essence of the living to sustain herself. Geist was torn. Obviously murder was ghoulish business, and undoubtedly Oathkeeper was not an entity that could be trusted... but still, the thought of having a second chance of reliving her youth was too good to pass up. And so she concocted a plan: after making a pact with Oathkeeper she would bind and ward him, limiting his influence and pull over her. Oathkeeper would still get fed; but on her terms, not his. However, as years have turned to decades; the strength of the Ward has weakened, and Oathkeeper hungers more than he ever has in the past...

beginner.whatItIs: Lady Geist is a spirit caster who pays health for power. She sacrifices some of her own health to throw a bomb or fire blood shards, drains an enemy with a tether to heal herself, and has Soul Exchange as her ultimate. Soul Exchange is not always a straight swap: the target first loses 30% of their current health. The swap only happens if the enemy is still healthier (as a percentage) than Geist afterwards; if not, nothing is swapped. Instead Geist gains the same percentage of her own max health that the enemy lost of theirs. The enemy is never pushed below 30% health.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her strong abilities cost her health, and her drain gets it back. So she needs to be on the edge of fighting, not standing far away, to keep the balance in her favor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like risk and reward. Use the health-costing spells when you can recover with the tether, and use the swap when your health percentage is low and the enemy's is high. It trades percentages, so a healthy enemy is a good target whatever their size.

abilities.lady-geist-essence-bomb: You spend some of your own health to fire a bomb that explodes after a brief delay. Aim it where enemies are standing to hit several of them at once.
abilities.lady-geist-life-drain: You tether to an enemy and steal their health to heal yourself over a couple of seconds. You can keep shooting while the drain runs, but you move slower, so use it when you can hold your ground.
abilities.lady-geist-malice: You trade some health to throw blood shards that stack on an enemy. Each stack slows them and makes them take more damage from your hits, so land a few before committing to a fight.
abilities.lady-geist-soul-exchange: Your ultimate. Trade your health with a single enemy hero, though there is a floor on how low they can drop, and you need to be close to land it.

name: Lash
role: Dives down to stomp his foes
playstyle: Lash gives his enemies little room to breathe, either by flying in from long distances to initiate combat with unsuspecting enemies, or pursuing said enemies when they try to run.

beginner.whatItIs: Lash is a mobile assassin with a burst-fire gun and a grappling hook. He stomps the ground, pulls himself through the air toward a target, whips enemies to heal, and lifts and slams everyone he connects with in his ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The grapple resets his air jumps and dashes, so he can chain movement well. The stomp is stronger when he dives from the air.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you love fast movement and diving onto enemies. Grapple to get high, dive for the stomp, and use the ultimate when several enemies are close enough to be connected.

abilities.lash-ground-strike: Stomp the ground in front of you to hit nearby enemies. If you press it mid-air, you dive straight down into the ground instead.
abilities.lash-grapple: Yank yourself toward a target through the air, and it also resets your air jumps and dashes so you can keep moving.
abilities.lash-flog: Sweep your whip in front of you to hit enemies and heal yourself for a share of the damage you deal.
abilities.lash-death-slam: Your ultimate. Focus on enemies to latch your whips to them, then they get lifted, stunned and slammed into the ground, hurting them and other enemies where they land.

name: McGinnis
role: Controls the battle with combat turrets
playstyle: Precise placement is everything for McGinnis, whether she's creating a killzone or splitting the enemy team. She can help keep her team running making them hard to dislodge when entrenched.
lore: Maggie McGinnis always had a knack for building things. At 4 she was using Lincoln Logs to recreate architectural marvels. At 10 she built and rewired a custom light fixture for her parents' anniversary. At 15 she designed a machine that refined the souls of the dead...that last one got a little more attention than the Lincoln Logs. Now the head of Fairfax Industries Military R&D department, McGinnis spends her time in the machine shop, not in a lab. She's not interested in theory, to her science is magic you can touch.

beginner.whatItIs: McGinnis is a builder who fights from behind her own defenses. She places a mini turret, a healing spirit and a slowing wall, and fires a barrage of rockets at a target area with her ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Where she places her turret, healing spirit and wall matters, because they stay where she puts them. The turret expires and does less damage to troopers and objectives, so it works best against heroes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like setting up a position and defending it. Put the turret and the wall where enemies have to pass, and use the rockets on enemies who are stuck in one place.

abilities.mcginnis-mini-turret: Place a turret at a spot near you that fires at enemies for a while. It deals spirit damage over time and expires on its own, so position it where it can hit the most enemies.
abilities.mcginnis-medicinal-specter: Drop a healing spirit near your team to top them up over a few seconds. It works on nearby allies, so place it where everyone can benefit from the healing.
abilities.mcginnis-spectral-wall: Cast a wall that slows enemies as it moves through them. You can erupt it to damage nearby enemies and split the terrain, and press your fire button to erupt it early.
abilities.mcginnis-heavy-barrage: Your ultimate. You call in rockets on a spot you pick and they home in over a few seconds while you are slowed, so time it well.

name: Mina
lore: Mina Ha had it all...rich parents, elite education, and an arranged marriage that would see her ascend from run-of-the-mill upper class to American royalty. She was happy. Then her betrothed was assassinated. Mina wept; not for the life of her fiance, but for the future that was stolen from her. Why couldn't the killer just wait until after the wedding? Then she'd have the last name she always dreamed of and no one would even have to pretend to love anyone. It could have been perfect, but life wasn't fair...and so Mina did what she always does when things don't go her way: she told her parents to fix it. Mr. And Mrs. Ha knew that the only way to appease their daughter was to offer her something greater than what she lost... and marrying into one of the world's most lauded families was a tall order to top. They had to think big. They had to think outside of the box. They had to promise their daughter immortality. It took a small fortune, but eventually they found a vampire who was willing to turn her. Unsurprisingly, Mina thought the idea of eternal youth and a trust fund was an acceptable plan B and happily agreed to the proposal. Now a fledgling vampire, Mina is quickly discovering that the clout she held as a human has no weight in vampire high society...and while at first that annoyed her, if there is one thing Mina has a knack for, it's learning the rules so she can subvert them. She will be the Viscount of New York, the other vampires just don't know it yet.

beginner.whatItIs: Mina is a vampire marksman with a burst-fire gun. She breaks apart into a swarm of bats to fly to a spot, adds extra spirit damage to her bullets, builds up a bite from her ability hits, and unleashes bats that silence enemies in her ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her ability hits build into a stronger bite, and each hero bite makes her ultimate send out more bats for the rest of the game. The bat escape makes her untargetable while she flies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want to mix gunplay with spells and slowly grow stronger. Use abilities on a target to build the bite, and use the bat escape to get away when a fight goes wrong.

abilities.mina-rake: Swing it at an enemy up close. It deals damage, and a kill made with it heals you.
abilities.mina-sanguine-retreat: Blink away from danger to a spot nearby and become untargetable for a moment. You can press it again right after to move even further.
abilities.mina-love-bites: Always on. Your shots deal extra spirit damage, and using your other abilities to hit an enemy charges up a bite that bursts for bonus spirit damage. Each enemy tracks its own cooldown.
abilities.mina-nox-nostra: Your ultimate. Release bats that chase enemies down; each bat hits for spirit damage and silences its target, and every Love Bites you trigger on a hero makes the swarm grow permanently.

name: Mirage
role: Times his shots and catches fleeing targets
playstyle: Mirage can envelop himself in a violent tornado to catch up to enemies and lift them up. His scarabs help him sustain against multiple enemies, and he's always ready to help an ally or punish an enemy anywhere.
lore: The Djinn are one of the more curious groups of people in the modern world. Possessing great power in controlled doses, Djinn are incapable of maintaining corporeal form for longer than 48 minutes without resting within a vessel. As a result, most Djinn employ human bodyguards for transport, protection, and companionship. Mirage is one such bodyguard. Employed by Djinn ambassador Nashala Dion, Mirage is in New York on a diplomatic mission. It's the hope of the Djinn that they can negotiate with the US government for a sale of part of Wyoming so that they can build a sovereign nation for their people.

beginner.whatItIs: Mirage is a wind-wielding assassin with a hard-hitting gun. He infests an enemy with fire scarabs that steal life, turns into a whirlwind that lifts enemies, collects marks he can cash in later, and teleports to any location on the map with his ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The scarabs both hurt and weaken an enemy's damage. The map teleport takes a short wait and is interrupted if he takes damage, so he has to cast it when no one is on him.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like roaming and joining fights from unexpected places. Use the teleport to reach a fight far away, and make sure you are safe while it charges.

abilities.mirage-fire-scarabs: Fire it into an enemy to steal their health over a few seconds and weaken their damage. You get multiple charges, so save a spare for a chase.
abilities.mirage-dust-devil: Blast forward as a whirlwind that damages and lifts enemies into the air while slowing them. Once you emerge, you gain bullet evasion, so use it to escape or chase.
abilities.mirage-djinns-mark: Press it to release every Djinn Mark you have and deal their stored damage all at once. The short cooldown means you can follow up with another burst quickly.
abilities.mirage-traveler: Your ultimate. You mark a point on the minimap and appear there after a short wait, but getting hit during that window cancels it, so only cast it when you are safe.

name: Mo & Krill
playstyle: By burrowing through the ground, Mo and Krill can get the drop on almost anyone; and once they get in close the results can be devastating.
lore: Mo and Krill are members of The Tunnel Rats, a group that help facilitate illicit trade and commerce between the boroughs thanks to a network of underground tunnels. But while most denizens of the New York underworld respect the work The Rats do, every once in a while a gang tries to exploit the tunnel system for personal vendettas...that's when Mo and Krill step in and remind the city what happens to those who disrespect their hospitality.

beginner.whatItIs: Mo and Krill is a duo, two characters played as one hero: a burrowing brawler with a spreadshot gun and a lot of health. Together they damage and heal off nearby enemies, burrow underground to move fast with extra armor, spray sand that disarms, and hold a target in place to stun them in their ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Their healing is stronger against heroes than against other targets, so fighting heroes up close keeps the duo alive. The burrow lets them close a gap, and they pop out with a slow and knock-up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick them if you want a durable fighter who stays in the middle of the action. Burrow toward your target, finish the burrow on top of them, then hold them with the ultimate.

abilities.mo-and-krill-scorn: Pop it when enemies are standing close to you. It hurts the ones nearby and feeds you health from the damage it deals, with a stronger heal when the target is a hero.
abilities.mo-and-krill-burrow: Dive underground to reposition quickly while gaining armor, then burst out to damage, slow, and pop nearby enemies into the air. Use it to escape danger or to catch a hero off guard.
abilities.mo-and-krill-sand-blast: Spray sand ahead of you to disarm enemies caught in it and deal damage for a short time. Fire it when an enemy hero is about to lock in a shot on you.
abilities.mo-and-krill-combo: Your ultimate. Grab an enemy hero close to you and hold them still while you pummel them, and if they die during the hold or shortly after, you permanently gain max health.

name: Nurse Harrow
lore: A respected pillar at the Marble Hill Possession Ward, Nurse Harrow has dedicated her life to combating the horrors of supernatural possession. A blend of care, severity, and detached pragmatism; Harrow has been called a saint by some of her patients, and a cruel governess by others. Both are probably true. But while any sane person would question how and why Harrow keeps the pain of her patients stored in her medical bag, none can question the results of her treatment program... cruel though it may be.

weapon.name: Code Blue

beginner.whatItIs: Nurse Harrow is a medic-style marksman. She throws leeches that burn through enemy buffs, uses a vial that speeds up actions for a short rush and slows them during the crash that follows, loads her gun with healing syringes, and opens a bag of terrors that stops enemies who look at her from using stamina or movement abilities.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her gun can heal allies, and dealing damage recovers charges. That makes her both a damage dealer and a healer, and she has to track her syringe charges.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like keeping teammates healthy while still doing damage. Use the vial when you need to act quickly, and use the ultimate on enemies who are looking at you.

abilities.nurse-harrow-leech-therapy: Throw it at an enemy to attach leeches that deal spirit damage over a few seconds while chipping away at their active buffs.
abilities.nurse-harrow-wretched-vapors: Use it on yourself or an ally to briefly speed up all actions and build up incoming damage into specters, which then hit harder when the effect wears off.
abilities.nurse-harrow-healing-needles: Your weapon fires syringes that heal allies, and dealing damage or collecting leeches restores its charges.
abilities.nurse-harrow-lurking-terrors: Your ultimate. Channel it to deal spirit damage to enemies ahead of you over a few seconds, and the longer they look at you the more terrified they become until they flee from you.

name: Paige
lore: The daughter of a rare book dealer, Paige grew up in a loving home that prioritized kindness, magic, and storytelling. But while Paige took naturally to her parents' values, her little brother Bryce did not. A rebellious teen, Bryce resented not only his family's saccharine attitude, but also their refusal to let him dabble in magics that they deemed too dangerous. Paige tried everything she could think of to keep him out of trouble, but like most teenagers, the more his big sister tried to tell him what was best for him, the more he turned away. Paige doesn't know what Bryce did to get kicked out of the house...just that she came home from the library to find her brother gone and her parents crying. Days turned to weeks, to months, to years. Paige grew to become a talented bibliomancer, making a living as a storyteller reading at libraries across the five boroughs; and while her parents have remained silent about what happened with Bryce, Paige's obsession with finding him has only grown. She will discover what happened to her brother... and no man or god is going to stand in her way.

beginner.whatItIs: Paige is a storybook spirit caster. She conjures a dragon that leaves a burning path, gives an ally a barrier and bonus weapon damage, slows an area and then immobilizes the enemies in it, and sends a wave of spectral knights across the city to heal allies and hurt enemies.
beginner.whyItMatters: She mixes damage with help for her team: the barrier makes an ally stronger, and the ultimate heals and damages at once. The area spell slows first and immobilizes after a delay, so it is best placed ahead of enemies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want a caster who also supports. Put the barrier on a teammate who is about to fight, and use the wave when your whole team is in the fight.

abilities.paige-bookwyrm: Aim it where you want the dragon to appear. It flies forward along that path, hurting enemies in its way and leaving a burning trail behind it.
abilities.paige-plot-armor: Give a teammate a barrier, and while it holds they hit harder with their weapon.
abilities.paige-captivating-read: Mark an area to slow down enemies in it. After a short delay it bursts and roots them in place.
abilities.paige-rallying-charge: Your ultimate. You release a wave of spectral riders that crosses the whole map, healing your team and hurting enemies, and the further they travel the stronger it gets.

name: Paradox
playstyle: Manipulating time lets Paradox outpace an enemy in one on one combat. She thrives by subjecting her enemies to timely swaps into a waiting pulse grenade, her wall, or into the middle of her teammates.
lore: Paradox. An artifact of time, and the name of a notorious thieves' guild... one that prides themselves on constructing elaborate heists that target the most untouchable of individuals and institutions. What does Paradox do with the countless artifacts, state secrets, and celebrity paternity tests that they have stolen? Put it on display at pop-up museums, so that they can show the world that no one is out of Paradox's reach. Shrouded in mystery, each member of Paradox dons a mask and takes on the organization's name. They are everywhere. They are nowhere. And if they want something, they are inevitable.

beginner.whatItIs: Paradox is a time-bending marksman with a burst-fire gun. She throws a grenade that pulses and slows, makes a wall that freezes enemy bullets and speeds up friendly ones, charges a time-stopping shot, and swaps places with an enemy hero.
beginner.whyItMatters: The time wall is a tool that works for the whole team: enemy shots stop at it and friendly shots get faster. The swap changes who is standing where, which can save her or pull an enemy out of position.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like clever positioning tricks. Place the wall between your team and the enemy, and use the swap to escape or to put an enemy into your team's reach.

abilities.paradox-pulse-grenade: Throw it into a group of enemies so the expanding pulses slow them and make your next hits against them hit harder.
abilities.paradox-time-wall: Place it between you and the enemy to block their bullets and slow enemies who touch it, while your own bullets come out faster and hit harder.
abilities.paradox-kinetic-carbine: Hold to charge a heavy shot that stops time on whoever it hits, and your move speed goes up while you are charging so you can reposition.
abilities.paradox-paradoxical-swap: Your ultimate. Fire the projectile at an enemy hero to instantly swap places with them, letting you escape danger or land behind their team.

name: Pocket
playstyle: With a powerful shotgun and a thin frame, Pocket relies on their ability to briefly escape into a mystic suitcase and teleport via a flying cloak in order to survive close encounters.
lore: Arin Fairfax, the eldest heir to Fairfax Industries, has been living in hiding for the past 5 years after being shot and left for dead on their 18th birthday. Arin doesn't know who is trying to keep them from taking control of their parent's company... but in the avarice fueled viper's nest that is Fairfax Industries it could be anyone. Taking on the name "Pocket", Arin desperately wants to keep their true identity a secret... not only for their own protection; but because they want to forge their own identity separate from their parents.

beginner.whatItIs: Pocket is a trickster assassin with a spreadshot gun. Pocket channels a barrage of slowing projectiles that make the damage grow, throws a cloak and can teleport to it, hides in a suitcase and then blasts nearby enemies, and puts damage over time on everyone close by with the ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The cloak gives a teleport, and the suitcase gives a place to hide while waiting to explode. The damage over time from the ultimate is non-lethal, so it will not finish a target by itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick Pocket if you like surprise and escape tools. Throw the cloak where you want to end up, and use the suitcase when you want to get out of damage and come back with a blast.

abilities.pocket-barrage: Channel this to fire a volley of projectiles that slow enemies near where they land. Each hit on a hero stacks up your damage, so use it during sustained fights.
abilities.pocket-flying-cloak: Launch the cloak forward to damage enemies it passes through, then press it again to teleport to where it is. Use it to reposition yourself quickly.
abilities.pocket-enchanters-satchel: Escape into your suitcase for a brief moment, then burst out and hit enemies around you with spirit damage. You can end the escape early by performing any action.
abilities.pocket-affliction: Your ultimate. You spread a lingering effect around yourself that hurts nearby enemies and cannot kill them, so pop it on a group mid-fight to keep pressure on them.

name: Rat King
lore: The cryptid ruler of the New York Warrens, The Rat King towers over his subjects in size, strength, and ambition. No longer content with hiding underground, the king has revealed his bold vision for a future where he and his subjects can walk the surface without fear of the pest control vans that roam the streets of New York (or as the rats call them: human death squads) Step 1: Take control of Long Island Step 2: Declare Long Island as the new sovereign nation of Ratannia Step 3: Execute every human that refuses to leave this new rat utopia But air tight as this plan is, the king of rats didn't want to take chances: and so he's decided to summon the patron to help hedge his bets.

weapon.name: Sovereign's Decree

beginner.whatItIs: Rat King is a scrappy brawler. He throws a scrap grenade that blows up several times, calls a swarm of rats that bite enemies and lower their bullet resist, puts on scrap armor that can bounce bullets back, and plants a banner that helps his team.
beginner.whyItMatters: The more rats are on a target, the faster they bite, so the swarm is strongest on one target. The banner only helps allies who stay near it, so where he plants it matters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like being the messy center of a fight. Use the armor when you are about to take a lot of bullets, and plant the banner where your team is going to hold.

abilities.rat-king-scrap-grenade: Throw it at nearby enemies to deal bullet damage and slow them with multiple small explosions. Use it when a few foes are bunched together, and watch for them to swat it away with a melee hit.
abilities.rat-king-rat-swarm: Call rats onto enemies to deal spirit damage and strip their bullet resist over a few bites. They can dash to shake a rat off, so use it when you can follow up with more damage.
abilities.rat-king-royal-pestments: Put on scrappy armor that gives you a barrier from your max health. While it holds, enemy bullets have a chance to bounce back at the shooter, so use it when you expect to take fire.
abilities.rat-king-rule-ratannia: Your ultimate. You channel to raise the banner of Ratannia, and while it stands nearby allies move faster, cannot be slowed, and take less damage, so place it where you can stay close with your team.

name: Rem
lore: An accidental stowaway from the world of dreams, Rem has found himself stranded in the city that never sleeps. Driven by his curious nature, Rem and his helpful friends have been seen wandering across the five boroughs in search of a way back home. So if you ever find yourself dozing off while taking the Blue line home from work, maybe you've just had an encounter with one of the Cursed Apple's newest denizens.

beginner.whatItIs: Rem is a sleepy support caster. He throws a pillow that knocks enemies back and shortens his other cooldowns, jumps to an ally to nap next to them and heal both, sends a helper to assist, and uses his gaze to slow enemies and put them to sleep.
beginner.whyItMatters: Landing the pillow lowers the cooldown of his other abilities, so hitting it matters. His gaze can see through walls and floors, so enemies can be caught without a clear line to him.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want a support who keeps allies healthy. Toss the pillow first, then jump to a teammate who is low, and use the gaze when you want a group of enemies to stop.

abilities.rem-pillow-toss: Throw it at an enemy to deal spirit damage and knock them back hard. Every hit you land also trims the cooldown on your other abilities.
abilities.rem-tag-along: Jump to a nearby ally and nap with them. Both of you get a heal that is stronger the lower your health is, plus some regeneration that lingers for a few seconds.
abilities.rem-lil-helpers: Send a helper to follow a hero or a trooper to keep them topped up with resist and healing. They can also collect boxes, and when no hero is around trooper souls are split with the team.
abilities.rem-naptime: Your ultimate. Use it on a group ahead of you, even behind a wall, to slow them and block their movement abilities, and once the channel ends they sleep until they wake up with a heavy spirit hit.

name: Seven
playstyle: Seven thrives in a skirmish waiting for the time to strike. Then he rolls into the fight like a storm and batters his enemies with a cascade of lightning.
lore: When mystic energy awoke on Earth, the world changed... anything was possible. But just because anything WAS possible, didn't mean that anything SHOULD be possible. And so the government made rules. Laws. A means for US citizens to enjoy the benefits of the supernatural world in safety. But rules and laws are for lesser men. Men with limitations. Men who were not Seven. There are many rumors about what Seven did to land himself in Lost Whisper, an oubliette for the most dangerous of occultists. But there is no doubt about what happened on the night of his execution. Wards placed by the most powerful ritualists of 7 different nations... wards designed to not just prevent mystical interference with the execution, but to simultaneously obliterate Seven's soul so that it could never be contacted, resurrected, or otherwise be used by someone looking to follow in his footsteps... failed. Onlookers viewed in horror as the strongest mentalist employed by the US Army's head popped like a grape. They screamed as Scotland Yard's premiere occult investigator, the one who allegedly captured Seven, crumbled to ash. Seven's body buckled and writhed against his restraints; his skin burning from eldritch electricity... and yet he would not die. He laughed. He laughed as he tore himself free from his bondage. He laughed as his captors cowered in fear. He laughed as he massacred his tormentors. He laughed as he tasted the fresh air that was denied to him for years. And he laughed when he thought about what he was going to do once he reached New York City.

beginner.whatItIs: Seven is a lightning caster with a burst-fire gun. He shoots a ball of lightning that slows as it hits things, charges an enemy hero so they are stunned a moment later, makes his bullets shock nearby targets, and grows a storm cloud around himself.
beginner.whyItMatters: His storm cloud and his shocking bullets reach nearby targets, not just one. The storm cloud does not hurt enemies who are out of line of sight, so he has to stay where he can see them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like hitting groups. Fire the lightning ball down a corridor of enemies, charge the one you want stunned, and use the storm when they are packed around you.

abilities.seven-lightning-ball: You fire a ball of lightning in a straight line that damages everyone it touches. It slows as it hits enemies and stops when it strikes a wall, so aim it through open ground.
abilities.seven-static-charge: You place a charge on an enemy hero and wait a beat. Once it pops, it stuns and hurts enemies near that hero, so time it for when a group is clustered.
abilities.seven-power-surge: Pop it before a fight and your bullets will chain shock damage from one enemy to nearby ones. It lasts long enough for a full brawl, so save it for when a group is stacked together.
abilities.seven-storm-cloud: Your ultimate. Hold it while enemies are close and in your line of sight, because the expanding cloud damages enemies caught inside it but drops them the instant they break sight.

name: Shiv
role: Bleeds out foes, then goes in for a kill
playstyle: Shiv has zero interest in playing fair, which is why he relies on hit and run tactics to weaken enemies before he dives in for the kill.
lore: A loyal member of "The Baxter Society", an international order of monster hunters, Shiv travels across North America looking to put down creatures that prey on the living. While his less polished nature and criminal past make some of the more traditional members of the Society wary, no one can deny his effectiveness.

beginner.whatItIs: Shiv is a knife brawler with a spreadshot gun. He throws knives that make a target bleed more with each hit, dashes through enemies and lowers their spirit resist, spreads incoming damage out over time, and finishes with a killing blow.
beginner.whyItMatters: His defense works by delaying damage: Bloodletting takes only part of incoming damage right away and the rest over the next 6 seconds, and activating it clears some of the delayed damage. Each knife that lands adds another 10 bleed damage per second at base (more with Spirit Power) and refreshes the bleed's duration, so stacks add up evenly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like hit-and-run fights. Bleed a target with knives from range, dash in with Slice and Dice when it is low, and lean on Bloodletting to survive the burst while you finish the kill or get out. Use the clear when your delayed damage has grown too large.

abilities.shiv-serrated-knives: Throw a knife at an enemy to start a bleed that grows stronger every time you hit them again with another stack. Each new hit refreshes the bleed timer, so keep landing hits to make it hurt more.
abilities.shiv-slice-and-dice: Dash forward through enemies to hurt them and weaken their spirit resistance, which stacks each time you hit them. Use it to close the gap and set up your other abilities on softened targets.
abilities.shiv-bloodletting: Part of the damage you take is delayed and paid out over a few seconds instead of all at once. You can also activate it to erase some of that pending damage, which is useful when you need to survive a big burst.
abilities.shiv-killing-blow: Your ultimate. You leap to a low-health enemy hero and instantly finish them, or deal spirit damage if they are above the threshold, and a successful kill lets you use it again for a few seconds.

name: Silver
lore: Lilah Silver is a mess. She drinks too much, she smokes too much, and the less is said about her personal life the better. But despite Silver's flaws she has managed to carve out a career as a successful bounty hunter, and while she would like to think that her successes are solely because she has incredible intuition, the fact that she's a werewolf doesn't hurt.

beginner.whatItIs: Silver is a werewolf brawler. Her gun, Hair of the Dog, fires a spread of 7 pellets at medium range and reloads one shell at a time, like a shotgun. She reloads instantly and shoots faster for a few shots, kicks enemies with her boot, throws a bola that stops movement abilities and stamina, and can transform into a werewolf with more health.
beginner.whyItMatters: Dealing damage builds bloodlust, more of it at low health, and a full bar casts the transformation on its own. So fighting hard is how she gets her strongest form.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want to start with a gun and finish as a monster. Use the bola on an enemy who wants to run away, and keep fighting to fill the bloodlust.

abilities.silver-slam-fire: Use it when you are in a fight and want more punch out of your gun. It reloads you instantly and lets you fire faster with extra damage against healthier targets, but your spread widens for a few seconds.
abilities.silver-boot-kick: Dash in to kick an enemy and mark them, then your bullets deal bonus spirit damage to that same target. Use it to close the gap on someone you want to focus down.
abilities.silver-entangling-bola: Use it on an enemy who is trying to escape. It slows them down and blocks their use of movement abilities or stamina for a short time.
abilities.silver-lycan-curse: Your ultimate. It builds up as you deal damage, and when it is full you transform, gaining extra health and stacking fire rate against enemy heroes while your abilities and weapon become ferocious for a while.

name: Sinclair
playstyle: With the help of their unwilling assistant, The Magnificent Sinclair can confuse enemies with curving hexes and rapid bolts.
lore: Henry's parents told him he was too young and impulsive to mess with real magic, and so they gave him a deck of cards to play with. He took to sleight of hand naturally and soon was dazzling his classmates with fantastic feats of illusions that were done without mystic artifacts or incantation. When he was in high school he met Savannah, and their mutual love of stage magic sparked a whirlwind romance. Soon they fell in love and created an act together. Obviously they were meant to be; and so at prom, Henry proposed to Savannah and they married soon after graduation. Unsurprisingly both sets of parents were not thrilled at this prospect, but Henry and Savannah knew they were soulmates. And so they cemented their love for one another by having a blood mystic bind their souls for eternity. When an on-stage accident claimed both their lives, no one was sure who to blame. Henry claims Savannah was out of position. Savannah says Henry didn't wait for his cue. But one thing's for sure, since their souls are tied to each other neither one of them have been able to move on. Now a bickering pair of ghosts, Henry and Savannah need to work together if they want to have any chance of undoing their eternal union.

beginner.whatItIs: Sinclair is a pair of bound magicians with a burst-fire gun. They fire a magic bolt that grows stronger as it travels, call an assistant that attacks whenever they do, turn enemies into rabbits, and copy an enemy hero's ultimate for a short time.
beginner.whyItMatters: The assistant adds damage for free whenever they shoot, and can swap places with them. Rabbits move fast but take extra damage and can do very little, so the hex is a way to disable a whole group.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick them if you like unusual tricks. Keep the assistant out during fights, hex a group of enemies before you start shooting, and copy the ultimate of the enemy that is hurting you most.

abilities.sinclair-vexing-bolt: Fires a guided bolt that gets stronger the farther it travels, and you can steer it toward your crosshairs mid-flight. If your Assistant is out, it casts a weaker copy alongside yours.
abilities.sinclair-spectral-assistant: Call your Assistant to a spot near you, and it shoots at enemies whenever you do. Press the button again to jump to where it stands, and the summon also tops up your magazine.
abilities.sinclair-rabbit-hex: Hex a target area to turn every enemy in it into a Rabbit that moves faster but takes extra damage and cannot perform most actions. Land it while a few enemies are close together to catch them all.
abilities.sinclair-audience-participation: Your ultimate. Copy an enemy's ultimate ability and hold it, then press the button again to fire it with your own upgrades applied, and it keeps the original cooldown.

name: Solomon
lore: In a world that moves too fast, Solomon is content to stop and listen. Offering a friendly ear and good counsel, Solomon has found himself sitting across the chess table from tourists, criminals, and titans of industry. But no matter his opponent, Solomon remains un-phased... because to him, chess is so much more than a game. It's an equalizer. A way for him to connect to people from all walks of life on an even playing field.
