beginner.whatItIs: Solomon is a chess-themed spirit caster. He places a bishop that stays in the world and can be moved, promotes an ally to a knight with a barrier, sends a pair of rooks forward that immobilize, and develops a queen with his ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Most of his pieces stay in the world and can be moved with the alternate button (the Rook pair instead flies forward and reflects back if it hits a wall), so he controls space instead of just firing and forgetting. The knight and the barrier help an ally, or himself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like thinking a few moves ahead. Place the bishop early where enemies will pass, and use the rooks when an enemy is near a wall so they bounce back.

abilities.solomon-setup-bishop: Place a bishop on the ground and it stays there until you recall it. Move it through enemies to slow and hurt them, then wait for it to light up diagonal squares that damage enemies who step on them.
abilities.solomon-kingside-knight: Send it to an ally to give them extra stamina and a shield, or cast it on yourself for a bigger shield without the stamina. You can move the piece to travel somewhere safely because it is invulnerable while in motion.
abilities.solomon-rook-battery: Fire a pair of rooks forward to immobilize and hurt whatever they hit, and they bounce off walls so aim them at corners. Press again to split them sideways and cover a wider area.
abilities.solomon-develop-queen: Your ultimate. Summon a queen that slams into an area for spirit damage and then releases lines of squares that hurt and stun enemies, and she can leap to a new spot to crash down again.

name: The Doorman
lore: He's proper, he's polite, but the humble Doorman of The Baroness Hotel is more than meets the eye. While he had only planned to experience life on this plane for a few weeks, The Doorman quickly discovered that the New York service industry was a great way to see the strange demands that please humans.

beginner.whatItIs: The Doorman is a hotel-themed spirit caster with a hard-hitting gun. He throws a bell that explodes and hurts enemy accuracy, opens two linked doors, sends a luggage cart that drags heroes along, and sends an enemy off to the hotel for a while.
beginner.whyItMatters: The doors are a shortcut that any player can walk through, and most projectiles pass through them too, so place them where your team gains more than the enemy. The luggage cart can pull friends instead of enemies when he alt-casts it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you enjoy setting up routes and surprising enemies. Place the doors before a fight so your team has a way in or out, and use the hotel ultimate to take one enemy out of a fight.

abilities.the-doorman-call-bell: Throw it at nearby enemies to deal damage on impact, then it goes off after a moment to hit them again and slow their movement and accuracy. You can shoot it yourself to make it explode sooner.
abilities.the-doorman-doorway: You place two connected doors, and characters and most projectiles that go through one come out of the other. Use it to cross a gap quickly or to slip past an enemy without a direct path.
abilities.the-doorman-luggage-cart: Send it out to drag enemy heroes along its path while dealing damage. Use the alt cast on friendly heroes instead to pull them out of a bad spot.
abilities.the-doorman-hotel-guest: Your ultimate. You channel and send an enemy hero off to the Baroness Hotel, and they must reach the exit elevator in time or they take extra spirit damage on top of the cost of their stay.

name: Venator
lore: The Venators of St. Benedict are a Vatican-sanctioned order whose members are deployed to regions with a high concentration of supernatural predators. Few in number, their modus operandi is to observe, identify, and exterminate. They are methodical, they are precise, and once they identify a threat to the flock they are relentless. But even amongst those who are called The Sword Of St. Benedict, one stands apart from the others. A man whose hardened heart has allowed him to pay terrible prices in the name of the greater good... and he has once again been dispatched to New York.

beginner.whatItIs: Venator is a monster hunter with a crossbow. He fires a grenade that sets enemies on fire and reduces their healing, blasts a shotgun that pushes enemies back, kicks a trap that immobilizes and reveals, and loads three stakes, the last one able to execute low-health enemies.
beginner.whyItMatters: His grenade burns enemies and his snap trap deals spirit damage, so weapon hits are not his only source of damage. A shotgun blast near a wall stuns, and the final stake finishes enemies who are low on health.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want a hunter who plans each shot. Use the trap to hold a target, push them toward a wall with the shotgun, then use the stakes.

abilities.venator-consecrating-grenade: Throw it at a cluster of enemies so it bounces and sets them on fire. While they burn, they hurt nearby enemies and heal less.
abilities.venator-gutshot: Blast enemies with your shotgun to shove them back. If you catch them near a wall, they get stunned and take extra damage.
abilities.venator-hex-lined-snap-trap: Kick it toward enemies so it springs on the first one it touches. It stops them in place and reveals nearby enemies for a short time, letting you see them.
abilities.venator-ira-domini: Your ultimate. Load your crossbow with stakes that deal far more damage, and the final one is blessed to deal bonus pure damage and finish off low-health enemies.

name: Victor
lore: A lot of people spend their whole lives wondering who they really are. For Victor, this existential question is made more complicated as he woke up on a mortuary table with no knowledge of his creator, why he was made, and whom he is made of. Now searching the five boroughs for answers, Victor is hoping to find someone who can identify any part of him.

beginner.whatItIs: Victor is a stitched-together brawler with a medium-range gun. He charges a battery by taking damage and fires shocking bolts once it is full, hurts himself for regeneration and speed, channels a pain aura that hurts him and enemies, and comes back to life after dying.
beginner.whyItMatters: Taking damage is part of his plan, so he wants to be in the fight. The aura gets stronger the longer it is channeled, but it hurts him as well.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you like trading health for power. Fire the battery when it is full, and keep the revive in mind: dying is not always the end.

abilities.victor-pain-battery: Build it up by taking hits, then press it to fire multiple bolts at nearby enemies for spirit damage.
abilities.victor-jumpstart: A quick channel that deals you some damage, then boosts your speed and health recovery for a short time. Use it when you need to close the gap fast.
abilities.victor-aura-of-suffering: Channel it to deal spirit damage to nearby enemies and yourself over a few seconds, and the damage ramps up the longer you hold it. Keep it up while you trade with a hero.
abilities.victor-shocking-reanimation: Your ultimate. If you take lethal damage, a wave slows nearby enemies, and after a short channel you come back dealing spirit damage and stunning them.

name: Vindicta
playstyle: Vindicta has the mobility to engage at her leisure, picking at her prey and bleeding them out slowly. Injured enemies at any distance should fear being picked off when she is on the map.
lore: A victim of John Hathorne during the Salem Witch Trials, Vindicta got a second chance of life when her spirit was brought back to the mortal plane during the first Maelstrom (the event that introduced the supernatural to the public at large). Waging a one ghost war against "The Friends of Humanity", a neo inquisition formed by Hathorne's descendants; Vindicta looks to keep the supernatural safe from Hathorne's ilk, and she isn't afraid to stack as many bodies as needed to do it.

beginner.whatItIs: Vindicta is a sniper with a long-range gun. She throws a stake that tethers enemies so they cannot move far from where it lands, flies into the air for extra damage, sends a crow that makes enemies easier to shoot, and fires a powerful scoped shot with her ultimate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her ultimate does only partial damage until it has been scoped for 1 second, and it hits harder against enemies under 50 percent health. While she flies, her bullets add spirit damage and her items reach farther.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like long-range kills. Tether a target with the stake, wait for the full charge on the scoped shot, and fly when you need a better angle.

abilities.vindicta-stake: Throw a stake at an enemy to tether them and limit how far they can move from where it lands. Use it to lock down someone who is running away from you.
abilities.vindicta-flight: Fly above the fight to keep your distance. While airborne your weapon hits harder and your items reach further, so use it to reposition or hold ground from the air.
abilities.vindicta-crow-familiar: Send your crow at an enemy to reduce their bullet resist and apply a bleed based on their current health, so it hurts most on a healthy target.
abilities.vindicta-assassinate: Your ultimate. Hold your scope for a moment to charge the shot to full power, then fire at a wounded enemy since it deals bonus damage to low health targets.

name: Violet
lore: Violet immigrated to The Cursed Apple when she was 12, and while there was a certain amount of culture shock to adapting to New York, she quickly fell in love with the vibrance of the city. Dedicating herself to the pursuit of the arts, Violet's passion lead her to successes far beyond most of her peers. First, a full ride to art school. Then in her junior year, inclusion in MOMA'S prestigious celebration of student artists: "The Upstart Gallery". By any measure she's doing phenomenal for her age, however Violet has not been able shake her existential dread of dying a failure. She knows that commercial success as a fine artist isn't about being good enough. It's not even about being great. It's about being seen by the right person at the right time. And so she has set her sights on The Ritual... not to embellish on her own talent, but just to have a chance to show the world what she can do.

beginner.whatItIs: Violet is an artist who fights with ink and a projectile weapon. She drags a brush that slows enemies, chooses a hero to sketch for damage over time, creates a circle of ink that blocks sight and rewards her allies, and has Living Ink: it empowers her next 3 bullets so she can steer them, they deal bonus bullet damage plus splash spirit damage, and each hero they hit lowers her ability cooldowns. Its alt-fire draws a solid ink stroke that blocks projectiles and characters.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her sketch hurts a hero as long as she looks at them, and finishing it adds a stun. The ink circle blocks vision, reveals the enemies inside it and gives her allies +25 Spirit Power, and enemies who leave it take spirit damage and are silenced and slowed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want a caster who works by keeping her eyes on a target. Start the sketch when you can look at the target for a long time, and use the circle to hold a point.

abilities.violet-living-ink: Your next few bullets come alive so you can steer them mid-flight, and each one that hits a hero shaves cooldowns off your abilities. For a wall instead, use the draw option to paint a solid stroke that blocks enemies and projectiles.
abilities.violet-flow-state: Drag the brush forward to leave a trail that slows and hurts enemies who pass through, while giving your allies extra slide distance. Flick it forward with a second press to end the trail early and burst spirit damage in a wider spot.
abilities.violet-still-life: Pick a hero and hold your gaze on them to deal steady spirit damage. If the sketch finishes, they get stunned and drop a pickup that permanently boosts your stats.
abilities.violet-abstract-landscape: Your ultimate. Drop a circle of ink that hides your team and reveals enemies inside, and enemies who leave it take spirit damage plus silence and slow.

name: Viscous
playstyle: Viscous vexes his opponents through clever evasion and strategic uses of healing, enabling him to withstand the most brutal of enemy attacks.
lore: The Bermuda Triangle was never a myth, it was a shadowline nexus deep underneath the Atlantic Ocean. For the most part, the things that escaped this astral gate were benign (like Nessie), but now something dark and predatory known only as The Adversary hunts the seas... and ocean denizens are scared to death. One of those inhabitants, a psychic sea anemone, wants to do something about it. Summoning an ectoplasmic goo body to traverse the surface, Viscous is desperately trying to summon the Patrons in order to keep The Deep safe from the horror that lurks below.

beginner.whatItIs: Viscous is a goo creature with a projectile weapon. He throws goo that leaves slowing puddles, wraps a target in a protective cube, punches an area with a giant fist, and rolls into a large ball with a lot of resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: The cube protects a target from damage but also stops them from acting, and it can be used on himself. The ball bounces off walls and gives a lot of Bullet and Spirit resist, so he is hard to kill while he is rolling.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want to be a tough, bouncy fighter. Use the cube on an ally who is about to die, and use the ball to dive into enemies while taking little damage.

abilities.viscous-splatter: Throw it at enemies to deal damage, and the puddles it leaves behind slow enemies who step through them, so use it to cover a retreat or hold a path open.
abilities.viscous-the-cube: Wrap yourself or an ally in a cube that blocks all damage and boosts their health regen for a few seconds. Tap jump to break out early if you need to act.
abilities.viscous-puddle-punch: Call a giant fist down on an area to knock everyone up and deal melee damage with a slow. You and your allies gain extra air control while it lands, and enemies can parry it, so aim it where a group is clustered.
abilities.viscous-goo-ball: Your ultimate. Roll into a giant goo ball that bounces off walls and lets you double jump, stunning and damaging enemies you crash into while shrugging off bullets and spirit shots.

name: Vyper
playstyle: With a powerful weapon (and deadly venom to match), Vyper can slither into the back of teams and assassinate high-priority targets in a storm of bullets.
lore: When it comes to breaking the law, not getting caught is a pretty important part of the job. Vyper never got that memo. Luckily for her, if there's one thing she's better at than being arrested, it's escaping out of jail. Having done time in every major prison in the tri-state area, Vyper has built an impressive network of street level lowlifes that owe her one. She's also built an impressive network of street level lowlifes that want her dead, but she tries to focus on the positive.

beginner.whatItIs: Vyper is a snake assassin with a rapid-fire gun. She throws daggers that slow more with every hit, injects a venom that does more damage to wounded targets, slides well on slopes, and throws a bola that can turn a target to stone.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her venom hurts more the less health a target has, which makes her a finisher. The bola slows enemies in the area, and a direct hit turns one to stone: a stone target cannot act, but it also blocks all damage except her venom while it lasts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like finishing weak enemies. Stack daggers on one target, inject the venom when they are low, and slide away.

abilities.vyper-screwjab-dagger: Use it on a single enemy you plan to chase down. Every extra hit on that same target layers on more damage and more slow.
abilities.vyper-lethal-venom: Inject an enemy with venom that bursts after a short delay. The lower their health, the harder it hits, and it still damages them even if Petrify would normally block it.
abilities.vyper-slither: Always on. Your slides travel farther and can go up hills, and you pivot tighter mid-slide, which makes it great for escaping or repositioning around the map.
abilities.vyper-petrifying-bola: Your ultimate. Toss the bola into a group to slow and damage enemies in the area, and a direct hit petrifies them so they cannot act while frozen in place.

name: Warden
role: Weakens his enemies and chases them down
playstyle: Warden leads from the front, jumping into the fray and hindering his opponents' ability to fight effectively. But what Warden considers brave, others consider reckless, and if he's not careful he can easily find himself in over his head.
lore: Most people think the supernatural came into the world 50 years ago. They're wrong. Its presence shaped folklore for generations... and as long as there have been people afraid of the shadows, there have been those who dedicated their lives to fighting in them. Coming from a lineage of militant alchemists, Warden's family always trained for the day they would have to stave off a mystic apocalypse... but as time passed the importance of the lessons seemed less and less important. What once was viewed as a sincere warning slowly morphed into being perceived as amusing anecdotes told by their superstitious grandparents. When the portal opened in Central Park, Warden's parents realized not only was everything they were told was true, they were unprepared. Refusing to let the next generation fall asleep on the job, Warden was trained since birth to be a supernatural killing machine with one purpose: stopping the Patrons from ever entering our world.

beginner.whatItIs: Warden is a heavy-hitting brawler. He throws a flask that lowers enemy damage and speed, gains a barrier and speed from willpower, curses an enemy so they are damaged and held if they do not move, and charges a pulse that heals him.
beginner.whyItMatters: The curse forces an enemy to move or take the hit, which pushes them around. His ultimate gives him 50% bullet and spirit resist only during its 2 second charge-up, not for the whole ultimate, so start it where he can live through those two seconds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick him if you want a tank-like fighter. Throw the flask at the strongest enemy, curse another, and charge the ultimate when you can stay in place for two seconds.

abilities.warden-alchemical-flask: Throw it at nearby enemies to cut their weapon damage and slow them down. It is a clean way to peel off a chasing enemy or soften a fight you do not want to win head on.
abilities.warden-willpower: Get a shield and extra speed for a few seconds. Use it to dive into a fight or back away when you are hurt.
abilities.warden-binding-word: Cast it on an enemy hero from a distance. If they do not move away in time they take damage and get rooted, so you want it on a target that is cornered or slow.
abilities.warden-last-stand: Your ultimate. After a short channel it pulses around you, hurting nearby enemies and healing you from the damage dealt, while you get big resist and are immune to fear.

name: Wraith
playstyle: Excelling at one-on-one combat, Wraith isolates targets, eliminating them with ruthless efficiency. Then teleporting away before anyone can retaliate.
lore: The cornerstone of the New York gambling scene, Wraith's organization is about as open a secret as it comes. However, thanks to a non-trivial amount of bribes, shakedowns, and blackmail, Wraith knows that she's above the law.

beginner.whatItIs: Wraith is a card-throwing marksman with a rapid-fire gun. She makes cards by dealing weapon damage and throws them for different effects, teleports to a spot, boosts her fire rate for a short time, and lifts an enemy hero and slams them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Her cards depend on her gun: dealing weapon damage is what makes them. Each card has a suit that gives a different effect, so what she throws changes the fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you like a shooter with extra tools. Shoot until you have cards, throw them at a target, and use the teleport to escape or to find a better spot.

abilities.wraith-card-trick: Shoot to build up charges, then throw the cards at nearby enemies. You can alt-cast to launch immediately, and each suit you draw applies its own effect.
abilities.wraith-project-mind: Teleport yourself to a nearby spot when you need to escape danger or reposition. It has a long cooldown, so save it for when the situation is against you.
abilities.wraith-full-auto: Turn it on right as a fight starts to shred an isolated enemy with the extra fire rate and spirit damage it adds. It only lasts a short time, so save it for the opening burst.
abilities.wraith-telekinesis: Your ultimate. Channel it on an enemy hero to lift them into the air and silence them, then slam them toward the spot you aim at.

name: Yamato
playstyle: Yamato uses precise strikes to decimate her rivals. However, such damaging attacks often will leave her exposed, so she needs to make every shot count.

beginner.whatItIs: Yamato is a sword assassin with a spreadshot gun. She charges a sword strike, grapples to an enemy and cuts them, slashes enemies to slow their fire rate and heal herself, and transforms with her shadow soul to refresh and speed up her abilities.
beginner.whyItMatters: The strike gets stronger the longer she charges, but it can be triggered early for less damage. Her transformation refreshes all her abilities and makes them faster, so it is a chance for a second round of damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick her if you want a sword fighter who builds to a big moment. Use the grapple to start, slash to heal, and transform when you can use all your abilities again.

abilities.yamato-power-slash: Hold it to build up your next strike, and the longer you channel the harder it hits. You can release early for a weaker hit if you need to move fast.
abilities.yamato-flying-slash: Fling a hook at a nearby enemy to pull yourself right to them, dealing damage and slowing them the moment you arrive. A quick way to close the distance on a target you want to fight.
abilities.yamato-crimson-slash: Swing in front of you to hurt nearby enemies and slow their fire rate, and if you clip a hero you heal yourself. Use it whenever you are already in melee range and want to punish the fight.
abilities.yamato-shadow-transformation: Your ultimate. You become invincible for a short window with faster abilities and strong resist, and landing a hero kill during it heals you and extends the duration.
